Grafts — conduit, origin and insertions for each graft

Notation of the configuration above, also accepted as input: conduit first, then insertions in order; commas between grafts. SVG-OM1-RDP is a sequential vein; RA(T:LIMA)-OM1-RDP a T-graft off the LIMA; free RIMA-OM1 a RIMA from the aorta; prefix an insertion with p/m/d for the segment (LIMA-mLAD; LAD defaults to distal).

GraftViewer was created by Sam Heuts (Maastricht UMC+), sam.heuts@mumc.nl — comments and corrections welcome. Anatomy: heart, great vessels, chest wall and coronary trunks from BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science, licensed under CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan; meshes decimated and re-centred (great vessels via the Me-TEE processed set, same licence). Coronary calibres after Dodge et al., Circulation 1992. Diagonals, obtuse marginals, septal perforators, the anterolateral branch, the circumflex continuation and all graft routes are synthesised on the real epicardial surface; contrast filling is schematic. Educational simulation, not for clinical use. The derived meshes are shared under the same CC BY-SA terms.
